newsitem.title: USA: AT&T, Stet close to deal - source.
newsitem.headline: AT&T, Stet close to deal - source.

text.p: AT&T Corp and the Italian telecommunications holding company Stet SpA are nearing agreement on an alliance, a source close to the talks told Reuters Tuesday.

"Something will be coming soon," perhaps before the July 4 holiday, the source said. AT&T and Stet have been negotiating an alliance that could involve AT&T or its European joint venture Unisource collaborating with Stet and several Spanish companies and banks in the purchase of Spain's Retevision. The Spanish government is auctioning off 60 percent of Retevision, which is to become Spain's second basic telephone provider.
In April, Unisource's bid was refused by Retevision because it did not conform to the rules of the bidding.
Stet teamed with the Spain's Empresa Nacional de Electricidad SA or Endesa, Union Electrica-Fenosa SA, the Basque group Euskaltel and several Basque banks in submitting a bid for Retevision.

The Stet-led alliance appeared poised to win the auction after submitting a higher bid -- about $805.1 million -- than the two other groups also bidding: Deutsche Telekom AG, France Telecom, Sprint Corp and Banco Central Hispanoamericano SA ; and Mannesmann AG.
